goal: Build the metrics catalog and the compiler of ADR-0002: a structured query in, parameterised SQL over the star-schema contract out, with structural refusal of anything outside the catalog, proven by unit tests on a synthetic DuckDB fixture.
out_of_scope: the real snapshot and any network call
SQLMesh models (S2), golden reproduction (S3b), the agent and its tools (S4)
any table or column name not in docs/contracts/star-schema.md
done_means: catalog/metrics.yaml defines obligations, award_count, avg_award_value, supplier_concentration_top10 and competition_rate with the rules of ADR-0002, the allowed dimensions per metric and a plain-language description each
the structured query has a JSON schema exported by src/agentic_bi/semantic/query.py; a validation error names the offending field
compile(query) returns SQL text and a parameter list; a test proves no filter value appears in the SQL text, including a value holding a quote and a semicolon
typed refusal errors, each tested: unknown metric, unknown dimension, dimension not allowed for the metric, unknown operator, filter on a field that is not a dimension, malformed time range
every metric runs on a synthetic DuckDB fixture built in tests/semantic/ and returns a hand-computed value, including an award with net-negative obligations and a fiscal-month grouping
queries run on a connection opened read-only with enable_external_access=false and lock_configuration=true; a test shows a file-reading table function is refused
uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pytest -q && python3 scripts/commit_hygiene.py
stop_and_report_when: a metric rule of ADR-0002 cannot be expressed over the contract tables: report it, do not change the contract
a dependency beyond duckdb and pyyaml seems necessary
hand_back: The branch s3a-catalog-and-compiler, pushed to origin and never merged, with the report committed as tasks/reports/s3a-catalog-and-compiler.md: outcome, the verification output, the test count and one compiled example per metric. The owner opens the pull request from the pushed branch.
note: Plan row S3a. Serves ADR-0002. The synthetic fixture is the only data source here; real values arrive with S1 and S2 and are reproduced in S3b.
